title: Pale Chests
description: A simple resource pack that reimagines the textures of regular and trapped chests.
body:
# Pale Chests

![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8794b71fea2174f51f4cd780cae35d416d87087c_0.webp)

# About the resource pack:

The "Pale Chests" resource pack gives the standard chest a pale look with a clean, pastel white outline. Meanwhile, the trapped chest features a distinct red outline that hints at its redstone nature, perfectly contrasting with the block's pale texture.

It is perfect for those who want to add variety to their game's visuals while easily telling regular and trapped chests apart from any angle.

## Note: 

Please do not install this resource pack together with other similar ones to avoid conflicts.
